full_page.content:
Page 140 Cont.
July 9
Dan. Jay hogan - 26 - infantile paral.
George Swoish - 51 - siatic rhumatism - quite helpless - has to be fed like child - in fearful pain ... now five weeks. This party was threatened a year ago with mastoid operation, was prayed for and has been well.
Tm Murphy - 72 - severe intestinal trouble. Supposed to have oper- ation in May .... was prayed for at that time and escaped ... now hoping ... for a time given ten months to live - his sister phoned ... wanting to know exact time he had died.
Theresa Wheeler - 13 - cancer of lung - Drs. give no hope - wanted to send her home but last night took turn for worse - now must re- main - Father baptist - baptized Cath ...
Page 141
Mrs. Stella Cousino - 46 - slight stroke - neck still weak & bent.
13 Madeline Mahon - 25 - Complication from spinal maningitis 9 yrs. - invalid since ten.
Cath. Jean Couper - 16 - Jacksonion - fits.
14 Victoria Kaczmarek - 47 - at Bay City - operation last Sunday (9th) intestinal obstruction. Drs. have little hope ... is enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses - 1.00
14 Carl Schumacher - 54 - Luthern paralysis and arthritis. Enrolled by Cath wife To-day.
15 Mary Jane Collins - 8 - in Children Hospital - Lauckiamia ... Drs. give - Parents promise to make Easter Duty if ... and Enroll her perpe- tually. -- Aug. 4th See.
Thanks - Mary J. Dorey - 45 - given 3 months to live - cancer of stomach last Nov. Ist - back to work befor 3 mo.
Cyril LaFevre 17 - spinal maningitis - prayed for July 5th - improv- ing ..... not out of danger.
Page 142
Mrs. T. H. Roberts - 52 - headaches and chest and heart trouble. Enrolls the poor Souls specially ($5.
